reuse.why: No duplicate-link check existed; the change builds on the existing db.first query helper, APIError and the shared LinkAccountBaseParams.upgradingId rather than inventing new infrastructure.

duplication.why: One check function plus one wrapper serve all five providers; the only repetition is each provider string and account-id accessor restated at registration, apart from the literal already written inside each link function.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers and runs before any write or sync; wrapping at app.method registration is slightly unusual but keeps the five near-identical link functions untouched.

scope.why: Only the guard, its registration wiring and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: A single assertBankAccountNotLinked holds the rule; a maintainer must remember to wrap any new provider's handler and keep the provider string in sync with the one inside the link function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses db.first and APIError; no existing link abstraction is bypassed (the five link functions are separate copies in the tree).

disguised_duplication.where: The check is defined once and applied to all five providers via guardBankAccountLink.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, applied to all five *-accounts-link handlers through guardBankAccountLink.
